name: lisa-simpson-qwen3-17b
reference_text: I still believe in God. I just think there's another path to him or her. I'm not just going to pick a religion that seems cool. I'm going to pick one that's right for me. Mr. Gere, I was hoping Buddhism could bring me inner peace. Or is that just a pipe dream? I'm planting my own bodhi tree. If I meditate under it, perhaps I can find inner peace.
